profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary: Seasoned Software Architect and Lead Engineer with extensive experience in AI-assisted development, JavaScript frameworks, modern web tooling, and leading software teams.

positions.title: Frontend Architect and Lead Developer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Provide overall technical direction and architectural guidance for a portfolio of frontend applications, focusing on automated testing, AI-assisted development, and improving developer experience.
- Lead the program-wide adoption of Amazon Q Developer for over 75 developers.
- Manage a direct team of 12 developers overseeing their professional growth, performance, and project delivery.
- Serve as Lead Developer for a mission-critical internal application, spearheading technical analysis, framework upgrades, and the implementation of new functionality.
- Interview and onboard new developers to expand the program’s capabilities and maintain a high standard of quality in our development output.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Node.js · Continuous Integration (CI) · Test Automation · JavaScript · Amazon Q Developer

positions.title: Front End Developer, Senior
positions.description:
- Developed software and mentored junior developers and reviewed their code, ensuring adherence to best practices while fostering a culture of growth and learning.
- Represented frontend team in Agile ceremonies, contributed technical analysis and ensured user stories were accurately scoped and prioritized.
- Worked hand-in-hand with backend developers, UX specialists, business analysts, and project managers, advocating for integrated and user-focused application outcomes.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Test Automation · Consulting · Bootstrap · JavaScript · Ember.js

positions.title: Software Consultant, Senior
positions.description:
- Developed frontend features for multiple MVC web applications, focusing on automated tests and reusable components.
- Trained new employees on frontend best practices, covering everything from JavaScript fundamentals to HTML/CSS to advanced framework development.
- Served in various roles in the software development lifecycle, including backend development (Java, SQL), UX design, and project management.
positions.insights: Skills: Test Automation · Consulting · Bootstrap · JavaScript

educations.fieldOfStudy: Front and Backend Web Development, Computer Science fundamentals
